title: City Council District 9
statement: This cycle, the council's full attention is rightly on the city-wide ask, and I'm ready to support the Mayor's agenda. But my eye stays on Laurel and Uptown — not because I expect trouble, but because quiet stability is exactly when you don't want to blink. My turf is holding steady, and that's a product of not letting good work get distracted. No manufactured motion just to look busy. I'll hold the line, keep the fundamentals focused, and be ready to step in the moment either neighborhood's numbers trend the wrong way.
